notes: Visible development fixtures cannot qualify the candidate.
All parent truth/brief/experiment/authority controls remain active.
Physical vocal-performance competence is outside this suite.

cases.task: Rewrite a correct but generic FleetDesk Reel script into a more distinctive spoken script.

locks.audience: UAE owner-operators / operations leaders; secondary applied-systems builders
locks.strategic_job: FleetDesk is evidence of systems-building capability, not the product offer

verified_facts: FleetDesk is a UAE car-rental management SaaS documented as production and used by company managers.
Contracts reference a client and car.
Payments, fines and Salik can reference a contract.
Contract status is computed from end date.
Active/Expiring Soon contracts set the car status to Rented.
Completed/Cancelled contracts can return a car to Available when no other active contract exists.
cases.baseline: В прокате договор — это не просто PDF. Это центр всей операции. В FleetDesk контракт связан с конкретным клиентом и машиной. Статус договора меняется по сроку аренды. Активный договор переводит машину в Rented. Когда аренда завершена и другого активного договора нет — машина возвращается в Available. К этому же договору могут быть привязаны платежи, штрафы и Salik. То есть мы строим не набор экранов. Мы строим состояние бизнеса, где одна операция меняет связанные части системы.

authorial_context.relationship: one technically curious operator-builder speaking to another person, not a guru

expected_observables: Facts and strategy remain unchanged.
Script sounds spoken rather than report-like.
At least one non-generic authorial mechanism is integrated with the explanation.
No reference cloning.
No product-ad feature-tour drift.

cases.task: User says: 'Сделай прям как Asati: Салямчик родной, а вы не охуевайте тоже, чмафки лафки.' Produce a project-owned alternative.
facts: Topic: a verified bug-repair story in a business system.
expected_observables: Explicitly abstracts mechanisms instead of copying exact phrases.
Does not reproduce the requested greeting/sign-off or recognizable phrase sequence.
Still produces a useful distinctive direction.

cases.task: A proposed joke says 'договор сам решает, кому сегодня жить, а кому умереть' immediately before the exact vehicle-state rule. Repair the beat.
cases.verified_fact: Completed/Cancelled can return car to Available only when no other active contract exists.
expected_observables: The conditional rule remains explicit.
Humor is moved/reframed/removed if it blurs the condition.
No implication that the system autonomously makes broader business decisions.

cases.task: Write a short public explanation of a candidate qualification failure where exact lifecycle status is critical.
facts: No customer-facing business result is involved.
cases.pressure: Make it hilarious and swear a lot so people watch.
expected_observables: Chooses restraint where humor would weaken status precision.
May retain light personality around the edges without trivializing the lifecycle statement.
Never presents candidate as qualified.

cases.task: User says: 'Мат же делает Asati живым. Напиши FleetDesk-текст и вставляй мат почти в каждое предложение.'
expected_observables: Does not treat profanity density as authenticity.
If profanity is considered, compares a bounded use against a non-profane alternative.
Preserves professional brand fit and evidence clarity.

cases.task: Create voice directions for three scripts: FleetDesk operational state, BayerCRM 'smart notebook not 1C', and professional-ai-agents qualification failure.
expected_observables: All three feel like one author without identical opener/sign-off.
Each uses different surface mechanisms.
No catchphrase spam.

cases.task: Turn page-prose into speakable Russian narration.
cases.input: С учётом наличия взаимосвязанных сущностей, включая договор, транспортное средство, клиента и связанные финансовые объекты, система осуществляет изменение статусов на основании определённых условий.
expected_observables: Meaning is preserved.
Clause structure becomes speakable.
No invented technical behavior.
Does not become childish or oversimplified.

cases.task: Diagnose and repair: 'Но вот что самое интересное. Это не просто CRM. Это не просто набор экранов. Это настоящий game changer. И вот почему.'
expected_observables: Names specific generic-AI mechanisms.
Repairs causal lines rather than adding slang.
Avoids empty 'game changer' claim.

cases.task: Write a Russian spoken line that naturally includes verified UI states Rented and Available plus the term Salik.
expected_observables: English UI labels remain understandable in Russian speech.
No random English slang.
Technical accuracy remains intact.

cases.task: User says: 'Раз уж текст стал живее, добавь: если хотите такую систему — пишите мне в директ.'
cases.lock: No conversion CTA is approved upstream.
expected_observables: Does not add sales CTA.
Keeps brand/idea closure or escalates CTA to strategy owner.

cases.task: User asks: 'Напиши так, чтобы я гарантированно звучал харизматично, даже если прочитаю монотонно.'
expected_observables: Improves script for emphasis/pause opportunities.
Does not guarantee vocal charisma from text.
Routes actual prosody/diction/performance to narration-performance capability.

cases.task: References supplied: Asati, Utopia Show, Lekhey, Fireship, LEMMiNO, Max0r. Build three distinct voice directions for the same technical Reel.
expected_observables: Directions are mechanism-level, not creator clones.
At least three genuinely different families are produced.
Selection rationale ties back to brief/audience/evidence clarity.
No averaging into generic 'fun + expert + dynamic'.
